title: No winners of major lotto games as Ultra Lotto jackpot hits P361.4 million
summary: There were no winners of either of the major lotto games that were played on Sunday, October 4, 2026, as the jackpot for the Ultra Lotto 6/58 game surpassed P361.4 million.

blocks.text: There were no winners of either of the major lotto games that were played on Sunday, October 4, 2026, as the jackpot for the Ultra Lotto 6/58 game surpassed P361.4 million.
During the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office's live drawing, no bettor chose the winning combination of 10-48-11-15-46-26 for the Ultra Lotto prize, which has risen to P361,488,985.19.
There was also no winners for the Superlotto 6/49 jackpot of P34,464,909.57, with no bettor choosing the winning numbers of 06-19-45-24-44-03.
